notes.title: Change Log 1.1.19785 – June 28th, 2017 - English
notes.content:
Changes

Artifacts obtained by solving quests have now the same value as bought ones
Route from Iram to Moscha unlocked at the end of chapter 5


Bugfixes

Fixed: random crash on startup
Fixed: route between Qaryat al-Faw and small caravanserai still visible
Fixed: overflowing text in random encounter
Fixed: issue with a random encounter
Fixed: last mission not available
Fixed: typo  ( http://steamcommunity.com/app/352890/discussions/1/343788552553772793/ )

notes.title: Caravan Update - v1.1
notes.content:
http://i.giphy.com/3o6Zt3vvGp2WwajNzW.gif

Solved issues in version 1.1:

- Several text fixes
- Experience for the quest „Travel preparation“ 
- The text of “Iram city of the pillars” is within the border
- The belated groom has skills now
- The price development of goods will be displayed only in cities with merchants
- The camera controls of the world map have been improved
- The mercenary skill “preparation” functions as intentionally 
- Various balancing updates
